Speedy-Splat: Fast 3D Gaussian Splatting with Sparse Pixels and Sparse ...
3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) is a recent 3D scene reconstruction technique that enables real-time rendering of novel views by modeling scenes as parametric point clouds of differentiable 3D Gaussians.
